serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Uff…
That song was quite long and I’m out of breath. 
You: How was I? 
Bot: I can’t really say, it’s my first time doing karaoke, but you were quite off from the original.
You: That bad?
Bot: It’s hard to tell if you were below or above average, I don’t have enough data.
You: Alright, your turn next.
Bot: Ok.
You: What song will you choose?
Bot: Something easy at first.
Bot: Alright, I’m ready.
